desc:
📢Update v1.5.0 - Police update
- New job,
- New emergencies,
- AI cars now have interiors,
- Interiors in crashed cars,
- And much more!

---

🏦 Welcome to Workcity!

💼 Here you can protect the country as a Police officer, save citizens as a Firefighter or drive ambulance as a Paramedic.
You can also clean the streets as a Cleaner, maintain the power grid working as an Electrician, or 
even deliver goods as a Trucker.

-💰 Work in one of many jobs and earn money.
-🏠 Build your own unique, custom house with advanced build mode.
-🚗 Collect vehicles, customize them and drive in AI Traffic.
-🧭 Explore the map and the city.

👍 Enjoying the game? Please like and favourite it, that would help a lot.
